meaning.neighbor_resolved_by_reported_hostname: neighbour resolved by the name the device reports about itself: inventory and device disagree
meaning.neighbor_resolved_by_address: neighbour resolved by a MAC or IP address, as no name was announced
meaning.neighbor_name_ambiguous: several devices answer to the announced name: none wins, stub
meaning.remote_port_is_mac: remote port announced as a MAC address, not replaced by an interface name
meaning.remote_port_is_aggregate: remote port announced by the name of an aggregate, member not determined: the cable stops at the aggregate
meaning.description_unparseable: non-empty description that does not follow the grammar
meaning.description_ha_unresolved: HA-form description (one pair per cluster member) whose pair for this member cannot be chosen: no cable, the reason is in `details.reason`
meaning.description_disagrees_with_observed: a port's description names a different neighbour from the observed one; the cable follows the observation
meaning.multiple_observed_neighbors: two neighbours observed on the same port; both cables are drawn
meaning.self_observation: a port names itself as its neighbour (loop, reflector, description): no cable
meaning.one_way_observation: observed from one side only, although the other side collected the same protocol
meaning.documented_not_observed: documented cable without observation: warning if both ends collected LLDP or CDP, info otherwise
meaning.aggregate_protocol_mismatch: different aggregation protocols at the two ends of a bundle
meaning.mlag_downstream_inconsistent: the two aggregates of an MLAG domain do not lead to the same device
meaning.mlag_pair_direct_link: two aggregates with the same `mlag_id` connect to each other: mislabelled peer-link
meaning.ha_view_mismatch: two members describe the cluster differently
meaning.heartbeat_link_not_observed: heartbeat interface without an observed or documented cable
meaning.link_speed_mismatch: different operational speeds at the two ends
meaning.native_vlan_mismatch: different untagged VLAN at the two ends
meaning.link_down: both ends are `down`; the cable is still drawn
meaning.documented_port_without_transceiver: `not_present` port whose description names a neighbour
meaning.device_partial_collection: partial collection; the failed topics are in `details`
meaning.parent_interface_unknown: the parent of a subinterface does not exist among the device's interfaces
meaning.interface_member_unknown: a member listed in `interfaces[].members` does not exist
meaning.aggregate_interface_unknown: an aggregate has no interface of the same name
meaning.aggregate_member_unknown: an aggregate member does not exist among the device's interfaces
meaning.local_interface_unknown: an LLDP / CDP neighbour names a local port missing from the interfaces
meaning.ha_member_unknown: an HA member is not in `devices`
meaning.heartbeat_interface_unknown: a heartbeat interface does not exist among the device's interfaces
meaning.vrf_default_case: a `vrf` equals `default` up to case or whitespace: a legitimate user VRF, or a misspelt global table
meaning.reported_hostname_differs: the name reported by the device differs from the hostname (ignoring case)
meaning.device_without_task: a device of the infrastructure has no collection status
meaning.documents_without_task: documents of a topic exist without a collection status for that topic
